test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The Great Wall of China was built to link existing fortifications into a united________ system and to keep the invading Mongol tribes out of China.
solution:
The correct answer is '**defence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Great Wall of China was constructed to link existing fortifications into a unified **defence** system.
 
• The primary purpose was to protect against invasions, particularly from Mongol tribes.
 
• The other options: "**ecological**," "**corporate**," and "**irrigation**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The Great Wall of China was built to link existing fortifications into a united defence__ system and to keep the invading Mongol tribes out of China.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ecological (पारिस्थितिक)**: relating to the relationships between living organisms and their environment.
 
• **Corporate (कॉर्पोरेट)**: relating to a large company or group.
 
• **Irrigation (सिंचाई)**: the supply of water to land or crops to help growth.
